company_overview: Vapi is an AI voice agent platform that enables developers to build, test, and deploy conversational voice bots in minutes. It provides low-latency speech-to-speech pipelines for automated phone calling and voice assistants.
target_audience: Developers, AI engineers, product teams, and businesses automating customer support and sales outbound calls.
